SELECT '员工工号' AS EMPID, '员工姓名' AS LOCAL_NAME, '人员状态' AS EMP_OFFICE, '所属门店' AS CPNY_ID, '部门编号' AS DEPTNO, '部门名称' AS DEPTNAME, '人员类别编码' AS EMP_TYPE_CODE, '人员类别名称' AS EMP_TYPE_NAME FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT T.EMPID, T.LOCAL_NAME, DECODE(T.EMP_OFFICE, '15120', '1', '15119', '0', '0') EMP_OFFICE, '1002', T.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT DEPTNAME, T.EMP_TYPE_CODE, SY.CONTENT EMP_TYPE_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY, ( SELECT MAX(CREATE_DATE) AS TIMES FROM SY_PORTAL_LOG WHERE CPNY_ID = 'C11' AND MAKE_RESULT = 1 AND ACTIVITY = 1 AND SUBSTR(PORTAL_NAME,1,3) = 'EMC' ) IFLOG WHERE T.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE = 'zh' AND T.EMP_TYPE_CODE = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.CPNY_ID = 'C11' AND (T.CREATE_DATE > IFLOG.TIMES OR T.UPDATE_DATE > IFLOG.TIMES OR HDN.CREATE_DATE > IFLOG.TIMES OR HDN.UPDATE_DATE > IFLOG.TIMES) AND HDN.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT TB.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT TB WHERE TB.CPNY_ID = 'C11' CONNECT BY PRIOR TB.DEPTNO = TB.PARENT_DEPT_NO START WITH TB.DEPTNO IN ('C113','C117') )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT T.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT DEPTNAME, T.PARENT_DEPT_NO, TO_CHAR(T.DATE_CREATED, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DATE_CREATED, TO_CHAR(T.DATE_ENDED, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DATE_ENDED, T.ACTIVITY FROM HR_DEPARTMENT T, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE T.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.CPNY_ID = 'C11' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO START WITH T.DEPTNO IN ('C113','C117')

SELECT T.PERSON_ID, T.EMPID, T.LOCAL_NAME, T.DEPTNO, TO_CHAR(T.DATE_LEFT, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DATE_LEFT, DECODE(T.EMP_OFFICE, '15120', '0', '15119', '1', '0') EMP_OFFICE, ACA.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO, ADCA.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO_ME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T, AR_CARD_ASSOCIATE ACA, AR_DINING_CARD_ASSOCIATE ADCA, HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE T.PERSON_ID = ACA.PERSON_ID(+) AND T.PERSON_ID = ADCA.PERSON_ID(+) AND T.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = 'C11' AND T.DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD CONNECT BY PRIOR HD.DEPTNO = HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO START WITH HD.DEPTNO IN ('C113', 'C117'))

SELECT T.DEPTNO, HDN.CONTENT DEPTNAME, T.PARENT_DEPT_NO, TO_CHAR(T.DATE_CREATED, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DATE_CREATED, TO_CHAR(T.DATE_ENDED, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DATE_ENDED, T.ACTIVITY FROM HR_DEPARTMENT T, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE T.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.CPNY_ID = 'C13' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO START WITH T.DEPTNO IN ('C132')
